[ffff64]Tunnel of Trials[ffffff]
Someone has set up another stupid trap here...
Aaaaah, what the heck are these things?!
This is the passage leading to the propulsion\nsystem which also serves as a pipe through which\nits power gets transmitted.
We need to be careful because those light spheres\nwill burn us completely and we'll vanish without a\ntrace if we come into contact with them.
Oh right, you could get burnt easily, just wait\nfor us at the crater base...
Oh nooooo!!
Whoa, I thought I was gonna die!
Ugh!!
Hang in there, I'll treat the burn.
Hmm, things are not looking very good here.\nThis ointment works fine on animals, but\nit doesn't seem to be the case on plants...
I'm not surprised...we Eumanos evolved from plants\nand to us, burns are a life-threatening injury\nthat cannot heal by itself...
Are you a fool?! You already knew that and you\nstill tried to save me?!
I thought I've got stronger after becoming a\nSproutling...But, I guess I was wrong...\nIt hasn't really changed.
Did something happen to you?
Oh, it's you guys! Why are you here?!
We think it's necessary to perform a maintenance\non the propulsion system.
This ointment might heal your wound...
Aaaaaah!!
Oh my gosh! What have you done to him?!
The burn on Muti's back is healing!
Hey, what exactly is that ointment?
It's the flowers Menberg grows.\nWe use it when we're not feeling well.
It seems to be able to revitalize plant cells and\nrepair cells that have become weak or damaged.
What?! So that means it's a plant activator?!
Hey, can you teach me how to make that ointment\nlater?
I don't mind, but why tho?
Well, it's been a while since the last time I\nfound a business opportu...Oh, what am I saying,\nw-whatever the reason is you don't need to know!
Thank you.\nThanks to your ointment, I'm okay now.
No, no, no! Even if you say you're okay now, you\nwere injured pretty badly. Let's not risk it,\njust go back to the surface!
What?! No, it's fine. I'm okay!
Did you forget that you're a Sproutling now?!
We can't let a brave Eumano warrior die in a place\nlike this. Don't worry, we'll take care of it from\nhere on...
Alright, I got it...Although I really wanna go\nwith you guys. I guess I had better not because\nI don't wanna be a burden to you guys...
But, please call me when you need me!\nI'll run to you right away!
